statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while Sunday closure leaves live NQ price-path evidence unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; the Sunday Globex reopening is the principal conditional WATCH window.
headline: Low Tail with extreme weekend Stress; reopening remains the key conditional window
body: NQ is closed. Friday's hawkish rates repricing, tech/chip weakness and unresolved Hormuz/FX risks keep reopening uncertainty elevated. Fresh independent research does not show a new discontinuity, and shared Finviz context is stale beyond 90 minutes.

Iran's navy says it has 'full control' over Strait of Hormuz

lookbackSummary: From Aug. 29 10:00 UTC through Aug. 30 09:00 UTC, Tail stayed at 19% with a normal mode. Stress rose from 75% to 80% as the weekend reopening approached; confidence eased from 96% to the mid-90s.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low while NQ is closed, then Stress rebuilds into the 22:00 UTC reopen. The first three reopening hours are conditional WATCH; meaningful retracement and two-sided price discovery would support rapid de-escalation.

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed. Friday's hawkish rates repricing and unresolved Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme, but no live one-way path or failed retracement can be observed.

news.title: Wall Street ends lower after Fed Chair Warsh reaffirms inflation fight
Iran's navy says it has 'full control' over Strait of Hormuz

forecast.analysis: If no new shock develops, closed-market uncertainty should ease slightly; Tail stays low because the gap, pullback depth and directional efficiency remain unobserved.

Energy headlines remain two-sided: Russian fuel restrictions add supply tension while the U.S.-Venezuela deal points toward potential future supply relief. Before reopen this affects Stress, not observed Tail.

news.title: Russia extends ban on diesel exports until September 30
Venezuela's interim president says US energy deal will last 25 years

forecast.analysis: If geopolitical rhetoric remains contained, risk should stay headline-led. A future directional gap would still need shallow pullbacks or repeated extension before implying mean-reversion failure.
With Globex still closed, weekend information remains unpriced. The principal future test is whether the eventual gap retraces meaningfully rather than its absolute size alone.
drivers: Gap quality matters more than gap size

forecast.analysis: If Sunday newsflow stays stable, Stress should continue easing from its weekend peak. Tail remains low until real price discovery can test persistence and retracement depth.
A quiet late-Sunday baseline would keep Tail subdued. Cross-asset alignment cannot become strong Tail evidence without corroborating NQ continuation after reopening.
If FX-policy concerns remain contained, this hour should remain mainly a waiting period before Globex. Disorderly yen risk is a potential amplifier, not proof of a Nasdaq trend.

news.title: Bessent says disorderly yen moves can destabilize global markets

forecast.analysis: As reopening approaches, accumulated rates, energy and geopolitical information may increase gap uncertainty. Tail remains low unless the later path rejects meaningful retracement.
Pre-open uncertainty starts rebuilding. If new headlines remain incremental rather than discontinuous, they should raise Stress more than Tail before any futures path exists.

news.title: Iran's Khamenei urges Gulf rulers in written message to confront 'real enemy'

forecast.analysis: The reopening is drawing closer, so sensitivity to rates and energy headlines increases. A large opening gap alone would still be insufficient for a Tail block without persistent follow-through.
drivers: Gap alone is insufficient Tail evidence

forecast.analysis: The final closed hour carries elevated gap and whipsaw uncertainty. The first live retracement, extension behavior and session-extreme persistence will determine whether Tail should rise after 22:00 UTC.
First Globex hour: conditional WATCH. A persistent gap with shallow or failed pullbacks and aligned cross-assets would raise Tail; an early two-sided retracement would argue for rapid de-escalation.

news.title: Wall Street ends lower after Fed Chair Warsh reaffirms inflation fight
Iran's navy says it has 'full control' over Strait of Hormuz

forecast.analysis: Second Globex hour remains the peak conditional WATCH slot. Repeated extension after a failed retracement would be stronger Tail evidence than the initial gap; stable two-way trade would weaken the case.
Third reopening hour stays conditional WATCH. Tail remains elevated only if directional efficiency persists near extremes; a deeper counter-move or volatility decay would support normalization.
If the first three hours establish two-sided price discovery, Tail should fall below WATCH even while Stress remains extreme. Persistent one-way structure would invalidate this normalization path.
Under an orderly overnight path with meaningful retracements, Tail should stay low while residual event and gap uncertainty keeps Stress elevated.
If extension attempts are repeatedly absorbed rather than accelerating, the regime should normalize further. Any fresh geopolitical discontinuity would require reassessment.
Assuming volatility continues to decay and NQ no longer holds an extreme, mean-reversion conditions would look healthier and Tail should remain low.
A stable late-overnight tape with balanced megacap and semiconductor participation would keep Tail low; renewed directional breadth would be a contrary checkpoint.
If no second information wave appears, the overnight regime should remain comparatively orderly. Tail stays low unless a delayed directional leg emerges.
Ahead of the European handoff, stable yields, energy and index structure would support low Tail. Cross-asset re-alignment in one direction would increase concern.
European participation can reprice the overnight move. A renewed push that erases prior retracements would raise Tail; balanced follow-through would preserve a low-risk path.
Later European morning trade becomes the next structural checkpoint. Continued two-way rotation supports low Tail, while repeated extension toward overnight extremes would challenge it.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is closed; weekend rates and Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme without observable Tail structure.
Absent a fresh shock, closed-market uncertainty should ease while live path evidence remains unavailable.
Energy supply signals are mixed, so they affect Stress more than Tail before reopening.
Contained headlines would leave the retracement test for the later reopening rather than this closed hour.
The eventual gap matters less than whether it can retrace meaningfully after price discovery resumes.
Stable Sunday newsflow would allow Stress to ease while Tail remains low pending live confirmation.
